text: Hello. Do you know where Charles is?
I think he's at lunch.
Oh, well. Can you ask him to call me when he gets in?
OK. I'll tell him.
Is Cynthia there?
No, she isn't, I'm afraid.
Hmm. We've got a meeting this afternoon, but Meeting Room 1's busy so can you tell her we've changed it to Meeting Room 4?
OK. I'll tell her.
Where's Kevin?
I don't know, I'm afraid.
Well, I need this month's sales report. Erm, can you tell him to email it as soon as possible? It's very important.
The sales report? Sure, no problem.
I'm trying to find Sue. Have you seen her?
Not since this morning. I think she's with a client.
Well, we have a meeting at two o'clock. Remind her if you see her, will you?
Yes, OK, Judith. Two o'clock. I'll remind her when I see her.
I can't find the key for the store cupboard. Do you know where it is?
I think Joseph had it.
Ah, well, can you tell him I need it?
OK.
